exclusions: Private helpers are excluded only as direct test entrypoints and portable implementation requirements. Inspect their logic for observable public cases and include their execution through public calls in statement/branch coverage.
Date parsing, formatting, timezone configuration, and context mutation are outside the calendar.* and epoch.* operation IDs assigned here.
No portable feature or literal expected value is exported from this API-reconciliation catalogue.

shared.date_fields: Civil fields are year, month, day; a Base date list may additionally contain hour, minute, second.
shared.weekday: Numeric weekday uses 1 through 7, Monday through Sunday.
shared.year: Functional DM5/DM6 helpers document a two- or four-digit year, resolved by the profile's YYtoYYYY setting. Base methods take a year value directly.
shared.research_status: Documented interfaces and source call routing have been reconciled. Exact outcomes for invalid arity, nonnumeric values, out-of-range fields, scalar/list context, DST, precision, and cross-profile differences remain unobserved unless stated below.
shared.binding_carriers: Base civil date/time/delta tuples are Perl array references, not flattened argument lists. A returned tuple is an array reference unless the operation explicitly documents a list return (for example week-year/week or all month lengths). Generic portable records represent the fields; they do not expose Perl references.
